# Decode Analytics Academy (DAA)

Academic environment focused on Technology (Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering). White-label platform for academic materials, PWA, and AI-assisted learning.

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite 5, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v3.
- State Management: TanStack Query (React Query).
- Backend: Lovable Cloud (Supabase) - RLS enabled.
- PWA: Offline cache (NetworkOnly policy for updates), dedicated service worker.
- Styling: High-Tech Dark aesthetic (#050508, Cyan #00f0ff, Purple #a855f7).

## Project Structure
- `src/pages`: Main application routes (Dashboard, Admin, Subjects, Readers).
- `src/components`: UI components, Notion-style blocks, study tools.
- `src/lib`: Core logic, curriculum maps (`subject-semester-map.ts`), Supabase client.
- `src/data/changelog.ts`: Detailed version history and audit logs.

## Core Features
- Digital Notebook: Block-based editor (Notion-style) for student notes.
- Academic Grid: Automated mapping of UNIP subjects from 1st to 8th semester.
- PWA/Offline: Advanced caching for study materials.
- Admin Workbench: Fullscreen Notion-style editor for creating and auditing handouts.
- Security: Dynamic watermarking, print blocking, and strict RLS policies.

## Development Principles
- Mobile-First: All features must be fully responsive (optimized for 100dvh).
- No Generic AI Aesthetic: Avoid purple/indigo gradients; use cyan/purple high-tech tokens.
- Academic Focus: No hacking/pentest references unless academic (Security courses).

## Branding & Attribution
- Developed by: Kaique Aurelio & Decode Analytics.
- Status: Always free academic project.

## Key Routes
- `/dashboard`: Main student hub.
- `/admin`: Management panel for handouts, users, and health monitoring.
- `/subject/:name`: Detailed view of handouts and modules for a specific subject.
- `/apostila/:id`: Advanced reader with focus mode and annotations.
